summary: Resources Connection, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 28, 2026, reporting that its Board approved a quarterly cash dividend of $0.07 per share. The dividend is payable on June 19, 2026, to shareholders of record as of May 21, 2026. The Board will reassess and authorize future dividends on a quarterly basis. This filing solely announces a routine dividend declaration, representing a direct return of capital to shareholders. No strategic alternatives, acquisition, or special situation is indicated. The filing is a standard current report on Form 8-K under Item 8.01 for other events, and should be classified as Capital Returns.
